claim.claim-text: 1. A juice extractor comprising:

a juice extracting drum that accommodates inside a screw for compressing a material for juice extraction; a cylindrical hopper that is coupled to an upper portion of the juice extracting drum and that has a space for accommodating the material for juice extraction; and a cutting part that rotates inside the hopper to shred or cut the material for juice extraction inserted inside the hopper, wherein it is characterized that the cutting part is supported only on a lower end side of the hopper, forming an open space where an entirety of an upper side of the cutting part is open such that the material for juice extraction can be supplied, the cutting part comprises a chopping blade that extends from rotation center part rotating and being supported only at a lower end side of the hopper, and extends above an upper end of the rotation center part; and a slicing blade that extends horizontally on a lower end surface of the hopper from the rotation center part and has a predetermined thickness in a vertical direction as well to push the material for juice extraction toward the rotation direction, a first inner protrusion is formed that protrudes inwardly from an inner surface of the hopper to support the material for juice extraction so as to interact with the chopping blade when the cutting part rotates, and the material for juice extraction inserted into the open space is shredded or cut by the chopping blade at an upper side of the rotation center part, the material for juice extraction transferred below the hopper is shredded or cut by the slicing blade and the material for juice extraction is pushed by the front surface of the rotation direction of the slicing blade to be supplied inside the juice extracting drum located below the hopper through an outlet formed on a lower surface of the hopper.

2. The juice extractor according to claim 1, wherein the slicing blade is formed such that inclined surfaces of a front surface and a rear surface of rotation direction of the slicing blade meet each other.
3. The juice extractor according to claim 2, wherein a blade is formed on an upper end of the slicing blade.
4. The juice extractor according to claim 1, wherein the hopper comprises:

a bushing part that is formed on a connecting hole formed at a center of a lower end surface of the hopper; and a driving force transmission part that is inserted into a hole formed inside the bushing part to rotate inside the bushing part, that has, at its lower end portion, a shaft hole into which an upper rotation shaft of the screw is inserted and that the upper end portion is formed to protrude above an upper surface of the bushing part to couple the cutting part, wherein an outer surface of the driving force transmission part inside the connecting hole is formed in a conical shape to correspond to an inner surface of the bushing part.

5. The juice extractor according to claim 1, wherein a second inner protrusion is formed that protrudes inwardly from the inner surface of the hopper of a position where an end portion of the slicing blade is located, to interact with the slicing blade.
6. The juice extractor according to claim 5, wherein the outlet is formed vertically below the first inner protrusion or the second inner protrusion.
7. The juice extractor according to claim 1, wherein an upper end of the chopping blade extends closely to the inner surface of the hopper.
8. The juice extractor according to claim 1, wherein the slicing blade is bent in an opposite direction of the rotation direction.
9. The juice extractor according to claim 1, wherein height of an end portion of the slicing blade gradually decreases as it gets closer in a radial direction.
10. The juice extractor according to claim 1, wherein the chopping blade and the slicing blade each extends in opposite direction to each other from the rotation center part.
11. The juice extractor according to claim 1, wherein the hopper comprises:

a hopper housing of which an upper portion is open and the cutting part is mounted onto its lower end surface; and a lid part that is hinge-coupled to the upper end of the hopper housing to open and close the upper portion of the hopper housing, wherein a safety guide part is formed to protrude below a lower end surface of the lid part to be inserted inside the upper end portion of the hopper.
12. The juice extractor according to claim 1, wherein the hopper comprises:

a hopper housing of which an upper portion is open and the cutting part is mounted onto its lower end surface; and a lid part that is hinge-coupled to the upper end of the hopper housing to open or close the upper portion of the hopper housing, and that has an additional inlet into which the material for juice extraction is supplied or a pushing rod is inserted, and the additional inlet is formed on an upper side of the center of rotation of the cutting part.
13. The juice extractor according to claim 1,

wherein a residue discharge hole through which residue is discharged is formed on an outer lower end portion of the juice extracting drum, and a residue discharge lower end forming a lower end portion of the residue discharge hole is rotatably hinge-coupled on a lower surface of the juice extracting drum to form the residue discharge hole together with a lower surface of the juice extracting drum.
14. The juice extractor according to claim 13,

wherein an immobilizing ring is rotatably coupled at the end portion of the one side of residue discharge lower end, and the immobilizing ring is rotated on the part that forms the upper end of the residue discharge and that protrudes outwardly of the juice extracting drum to immobilize the residue discharge lower end.
15. The juice extractor according to claim 1, wherein a comb protrusion protruding inwardly longitudinally is formed along a circumferential direction, on the inner surface of the hopper.
16. The juice extractor according to claim 1, wherein at an edge of the outlet, an inclined surface is formed towards the outlet.
